Included bundled sub-flows: `bundle/perps-list`, `perps/navigate-to-market-detail`.
Worker report # TAT-2964 Report ## Summary Perps market token logos were rendered on the design-system avatar default background, which becomes dark in dark mode and made transparent ETH artwork hard to see. The fix forces Perps token logos onto a white circular background while preserving caller classes. ## Root cause `ui/components/app/perps/perps-token-logo/perps-token-logo.tsx:101` passed Perps icon URLs to `AvatarToken` without overriding the avatar base background. `AvatarToken` renders transparent SVGs inside an `AvatarBase` whose default background is `bg-section`; on dark Perps cards this computed to a dark circle, causing the ETH logo to blend into the UI. ## Changes - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-token-logo/perps-token-logo.tsx` — merges `bg-white` into the resolved `AvatarToken` class list. - `ui/components/app/perps/perps-token-logo/perps-token-logo.test.tsx` — asserts resolved Perps token logos include the white background class, including with custom classes. ## Test plan - `yarn lint` — passed. - `NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=8192' yarn lint:tsc` — passed. - `yarn lint:format` — passed. - `yarn jest ui/components/app/perps/perps-token-logo/perps-token-logo.test.tsx --no-coverage` — passed, 10 tests. - `yarn test:unit:coverage ui/components/app/perps/perps-token-logo/perps-token-logo.test.tsx --coverageReporters=text-summary` — passed. - `node temp/recipes/validate-recipe.js --recipe .task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/recipe.json --cdp-port 6666 --skip-manual --artifacts-dir .task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/after-run` — passed 16/16. - Recipe coverage audit: `.task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/recipe-coverage.md` — 4/4 ACs proven. ## Evidence - Before video: `.task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/before.mp4` - After video: `.task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/after.mp4` - Screenshots: dark list/detail and light list before/after. - Trace: `.task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/trace.json` - Evidence manifest: `.task/fix/tat-2964-0514-112825/artifacts/evidence-manifest.json` ## Ticket TAT-2964: https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-2964
